caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a wrought iron gate or railing, rendered in grayscale. The object consists of vertical bars with ornate, symmetrical foliage and scrollwork patterns at both the lower and upper sections. The lower portion of the gate displays stylized floral motifs branching outwards. Above, the bars curve and intersect in pointed arches, forming Gothic-style patterns capped with curled accents on the ends. The structure is framed by horizontal and vertical bars on the edges, and it stands on small, curved feet at the bottom. The background behind the gate is plain with subtle shading to suggest depth, but no distinct objects or scenery are shown. The entire composition is drawn with fine lines and shading, giving a sense of three-dimensionality to the decorative metalwork.
title: Cast Iron Gate Railing
